description: Returns one loan's monthly reports back to its first filing (late 2016 at the earliest): balance, payment status, special servicing, workout strategy, modification, coverage and occupancy. Use it to see how a loan reached its current state. Without a key it returns a notice that a key is needed; the loan page on cmbs.news shows the last 12 monthly reports.

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans

name: get_loan_history

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation getLoanHistory). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

asOf.description: Data date of the loan record (latest reporting-period end in the database), YYYY-MM-DD.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

candidates.description: On a found: false answer: the closest real records, most likely first; empty when nothing is close.

items.description: One real record close to what was asked.

class.description: A certificate class: its class as the trust files it, e.g.

leftTheTrusts.description: A loan: true when it paid off or left the trusts, so its page shows its last figures.

slug.description: A loan: its slug, to pass to get_loan.

trust.description: A certificate class: the slug of its trust.

trustName.description: A certificate class: the name of its trust.

error.description: 'history temporarily unavailable': the history read failed; months is empty and from/to are null.

found.description: Present only when the loan asked for is not on file: false.

from.description: First month in months, YYYY-MM; null when there are none.

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

matchNote.description: Present when the text sent was not an exact identifier but fit exactly one record: how it was read, so the caller can check it is the record meant.

missing.description: Notes of the loan for which no history record was found (their balances are not in months).

asset.description: Asset number of the note in that trust.

months.description: One row per calendar month in which at least one of the loan's notes filed a report, oldest first, back to the first ABS-EE filing (late 2016 at the earliest).

balance.description: Loan balance in dollars that month: sum of the notes' actual ending balances; a note that skipped the month between its first and last reports counts at its last reported balance.

dscr.description: NOI DSCR as filed that month, a plain ratio, from one note (the same note every month); null when that note left it blank or the loan is filed property by property.

modified.description: True when any note's report that month has modifiedIndicator true.

msReturn.description: Most recent return-to-master-servicer date as filed that month (first note that files one), YYYY-MM-DD. Can predate ssTransfer.

noi.description: NOI in dollars on a full-year basis as read from that month's filing, from the same note; null when the statement shows no year basis, when the loan is filed property by property, or when the record...

occupancy.description: Physical occupancy that month as a fraction of 1, from the same note; null when blank.

rate.description: Interest rate for that reporting period as a fraction of 1 (from the figure note, else the largest note).

reported.description: Count of the loan's notes that filed a report that month.

source.description: The SEC filing that supplied the month (for the first reporting note).

ssTransfer.description: Most recent special servicer transfer date as filed that month (first note that files one), YYYY-MM-DD. It stays filled after the loan returns, so read withSS for the state.

status.description: Schedule AL payment status code that month: the worst across the notes that reported (severity 5 > 3 > 2 > 1 > 4 > B > A > 0). Values: 0 = Current; 1 = 30-59 days delinquent; 2 = 60-89 days delinquent; 3 = 90+ days delinquent; 4 = Performing matured balloon; 5 = Non performing matured balloon; A = Payment not received but still in grace period or not yet due; B = Late payment but less than 30 days delinquent.

statusLabel.description: Label of status; null when status is null.

total.description: Count of the loan's notes open that month (reported plus those carried at their last balance).

valuation.description: Most recent valuation amount in dollars as filed that month (the note's property rows summed); null on a loan filed property by property or when not filed.

withSS.description: True when any note's report that month shows a special servicer transfer date on or before its period end with no later return-to-master date.

workout.description: Schedule AL workoutStrategyCode filed that month (first note that files one); null when none. Values: 1 = Modification; 2 = Foreclosure; 3 = Bankruptcy; 4 = Extension; 5 = Note sale; 6 = DPO; 7 = REO; 8 = Resolved; 9 = Pending return to master servicer; 10 = Deed-in-lieu of Foreclosure; 11 = Full Payoff; 12 = Reps and Warranties; 13 = TBD; 98 = Other.

workoutLabel.description: Label of workout; null when workout is null.

nextCall.description: On a found: false answer: the exact call to make next, as {tool, arguments}. An argument written in <angle brackets> is a template to fill in.

noiNote.description: Sentence present when monthly NOI is withheld because this loan's history has not been re-read under the current annualization rule (every months[].noi is then null).

onFile.description: Part of the proRequired answer shape, but getLoanHistory passes null so it is never emitted here (it is on getLoanParties).

plan.description: Free plan only. Values: free = Free plan.

label.description: Fixed label: SEC Form ABS-EE, Exhibit 102 (Schedule AL), as each trust filed it.

trusts.description: The trusts whose filings the history was built from.

sourceLine.description: Fixed source and terms line (same text as source on other endpoints).

to.description: Last month in months, YYYY-MM; null when there are none.

title: Full monthly history of a loan
